title: Local Trouble
caption: Local Trouble (V)
game_text: At the beginning of your battle phase, use 1 Force to initiate a battle between two Imperials and an opponent’s character present at same interior site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and opponent takes no battle damage here.
lore: “Looks like somebody’s beginning to take an interest in your handiwork.” Imperial stormtroopers coerce local residents to assist them in the apprehension of Rebel scum.

notes: Non-unique: the slip title/caption and both scans print 'Local Trouble' with NO dot, although the wiki base page says |uniqueness=Unique — followed the printed card (no dot). Icon column empty (only the set symbol); no scomp ring. Lore corrected from scan: the quotation is in curly double quotes “…” and 'somebody’s' has a curly apostrophe (wiki uses straight single quotes). Base scan 745 px (Premiere-D-localtrouble.gif) carries a 'D-E1' label (Decipher errata printing: text says 'any two of your Stormtroopers' where the archive face says 'any two Stormtroopers') — top half is the printed face; copyright line legible: 1995. The 350 px printed archive face (Premiere-D-localtrouble-decipher-archive.gif, the wiki's base page image) also downloaded to src/vs2/, not used. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB1-D-localtrouble-pre.gif, 350 px) — used as modern. Not unique (Bill 2026-10-12): the printed card and the slip have no dot; the wiki base page was wrong.
